decisions.action: Retain installed species and Nutt. authorship; published 1835. POWO treats this species as accepted and lists 22 heterotypic synonyms; do not assume those 22 cover all historical varieties formerly included by other authorities.

Under POWO, the historical A. purpurea var. longiseta is a synonym of accepted A. longiseta, not automatically an alias to the narrow A. purpurea species concept. Older FNA/USFS/NMSU sources include it as a variety of a broader A. purpurea. Do not automatically relabel any installed A. purpurea photographs or specimen records without individual evidence.

POWO recognizes A. fendleriana as accepted and lists var. fendleriana as its homotypic synonym. Var. fendleri Vasey is a heterotypic, nomen nudum synonym of A. fendleriana; keep full name and status distinct.

POWO places var. nealleyi under separately accepted A. glauca. It lists A. purpurea var. glauca as homotypic synonym of A. glauca. ITIS and USFS historical accounts may recognize var. nealleyi under A. purpurea: preserve source-specific rank/circumscription.

POWO accepts A. curvifolia separately and places var. curvifolia as its synonym; the 1995 Allred & Valdes-Reyna primary paper reports reinstating A. curvifolia. Do not conflate this historical variety with A. purpurea sensu stricto.

decisions.rank: 1984 one species/seven varieties vs current POWO split species
decisions.action: Allred's 1984 morphometric revision grouped the Purpureae complex as one species with seven varieties, whereas current POWO accepts several of those names as separate species. Preserve both treatments with their dates. Do not apply broad 1984/1997 specimen concepts as automatic evidence for POWO's narrower name concept.

decisions.source_name: Historical field-ID descriptions including var. longiseta
decisions.action: The canonical card currently uses variety-aware glume measurements, including var. longiseta. Those morphology statements may describe broad A. purpurea sensu FNA/USFS rather than narrow POWO A. purpurea; taxonomy-only review cannot determine which installed photos or measurements apply to the narrower concept. Hand off to specimen/field-ID review without editing species card.
